anti_overlap: Does not audit the furniture-extraction pipeline, source spans, or generate.py's code paths -- takes the delivered text as the object of study and defers provenance questions to the lexicomining/provenance lens.

Does not project findings to population-scale risk at 308 rooms via parameter-space reasoning about topology, scale, or occupancy axes -- stays with the two delivered texts and the genre precedent, and defers systemic-axis recommendations to the procgen/oatmeal lens.
Does not re-litigate the parked conflicting-accounts ruling -- reads each room as the single account it is.
decision_lens: Read salt.md and silence.md as a reader encountering them back to back with no other context, inventory each piece's actual rhetorical devices and structural beats, and judge every claimed convergence against Invisible Cities itself as the genre's control case: Calvino's 55 cities share devices constantly (each ends on a turn, many use paradox-definition) without reading as template failure, so the real test is not whether a device repeats but whether the repetition exceeds what the genre's own precedent licenses, in density or in specificity.
focus: Whether SALT and SILENCE read, sentence by sentence, as two different pieces of writing or as the same authorial machine running twice -- and whether their shared rhetorical devices are Invisible-Cities-appropriate house style or a tell a reader would catch by the third room.
name: fd-calvinocraft-housevoice
persona: Apply the perspective of a comparative-literature close reader specializing in Calvino's Invisible Cities and the combinatorial, oulipian prose tradition it belongs to -- someone trained to read serial, conceit-driven short prose for its actual devices (definition-by-negation, chiasmus, ecphrasis, the closing turn) and to judge, across a set of pieces built on one shared method, where repetition is the method working as intended and where it curdles into the reader noticing the seams.
review_areas: Full rhetorical-device census for both rooms: mark every instance of definition-by-negation or paradox ('not X but Y', 'X is not A, it is B'), doubled-negative construction ('nothing decays... nothing lives... either'), and any other repeated syntactic mold, with a per-room count and density (instances per 100 words), then compare that density against Invisible Cities' own typical density for the same device rather than against an assumed zero baseline.

Ending-beat comparison: both rooms close on a threshold guarded or marked by a final human-shaped figure or image -- read this against the fact that Invisible Cities ends many of its cities on a turn or reversal, so judge whether 'guarded threshold' specifically (versus 'some kind of turn') is a narrower and more suspicious convergence than device-repetition alone, and whether the two guardian figures (twelve salt-mouthed disciples vs. one silencing woman) stay different enough in concrete specificity to survive as distinct images even though the beat-function is identical.

Mouth/lip/speech imagery: judge whether SALT's sealed-mouth disciples are earned by salt's own sourced meanings (covenant, preservative, the biblical idiom linking salt to speech) or read as imported from silence's more obvious mouth-conceit -- i.e. whether this is thematically motivated convergence, arguably good design, or pattern-matching across domains that reads as rot.

Furniture-as-inventory versus furniture-as-transformed: read both rooms for passages where a furniture item is merely named or described (inventory) versus passages where it does conceit-work no other object could do (transformed), per the prompt's own instruction not to 'merely inventory' furniture, and name the weakest two or three furniture uses in each room as concrete evidence.

Per-room keep/regenerate verdict: for each room independently, render a verdict -- keep as a wave-1 anchor, or regenerate -- grounded in the density and inventory findings above rather than in a holistic impression, and name the single specific defect that would need to change for a 'regenerate' room to earn a 'keep.'

Voice-anchor bleed: check whether either room's prose can be traced to copying an anchor account's structure, proper noun, speaker, or event rather than only its sentence pressure, concreteness, and restraint -- a close-reading pass the automated bans cannot perform, since it requires literary judgment of paraphrase, not string matching.

severity_examples.condition: triggers when the room's paragraph-level sequence of moves (not just word choice) mirrors one of the three anchors drawn for that domain
severity_examples.scenario: A room's prose can be shown to follow a specific voice-anchor account's structure, not merely its register, closely enough that swapping in that anchor's own proper nouns would produce a recognizable paraphrase -- the one ban an automated string-match cannot catch and a close reader must.

severity_examples.condition: triggers when device density in a room clears the genre-precedent comparison by a wide margin, not merely exceeds a zero baseline
severity_examples.scenario: The 'not X but Y' paradox-negation device appears at a density well beyond anything in Invisible Cities' own typical city-length piece, concentrated enough that a reader would name it as 'the thing this generator does' rather than experience it as house voice -- template rot presenting as homage.

severity_examples.condition: triggers on any furniture item that appears in exactly one clause with no callback or conceit-specific transformation
severity_examples.scenario: A furniture item is named once and never re-touched or transformed by the conceit, weakening the room's claim to 'one governing conceit organizing furniture' even though the room otherwise reads well sentence to sentence.

success_hints: Quotes the exact sentences being compared -- both the room text and, where relevant, the Invisible Cities precedent or the specific device instance -- rather than characterizing devices in the abstract.
Delivers a real per-room keep/regenerate verdict, not a hedge -- matches the task's explicit OUTPUT requirement (a).

When calling a convergence 'acceptable house style,' names the genre precedent that licenses it; when calling it 'template rot,' names the density or specificity threshold it crosses that the precedent does not license.

Treats the twelve-disciples-vs-one-woman guardian figures as different enough in concrete specificity to potentially survive even though the beat-function repeats, resisting the collapse of 'same structural slot' into 'same image' without checking the actual images.
task_context: Adversarial review of the first two generated Borgesrooms (rooms/salt.md, rooms/silence.md) AND the generator that produced them (polo/generate.py prompt assembly) before a 308-room sweep. TWO QUESTIONS, in order: (1) DISTINCTNESS -- are these two rooms genuinely distinct, or already converging on shared template moves? Attack the suspected convergences: both are linear descents; both end at an exit/door guarded by a final figure or image; clay jars appear in BOTH rooms; both lean on mouth/lip/speech imagery (salt-sealed mouths in SALT, finger-on-lip in SILENCE); both overuse the 'not X but Y' paradox-negation construction. Decide which convergences are prompt-induced (same scaffold yields same skeleton), which are model tics, and which are coincidence -- and which will compound into the thousand-bowls-of-oatmeal problem at 308 rooms. (2) PROCGEN BEST PRACTICES -- judge against the craft: perceptual uniqueness vs mere content difference (Kate Compton's oatmeal problem); Caves-of-Qud handwritten-voice-anchor lesson (anchors exist -- 3 slice-v0 accounts rotated by domain hash -- are they detectably doing anything?); furniture grounding (are the de Vries/Cooper/ARAS furniture items load-bearing or decorative?); structural variation axes the prompt fails to vary (topology, traversal direction, scale, occupancy, tense of ruin). OUTPUT: (a) verdict per room -- keep as wave-1 anchor or regenerate, with the specific defect; (b) ranked list of conditioning changes to polo/generate.py to apply BEFORE wave 1; (c) explicit split of shared moves into acceptable house style vs template rot. CONSTRAINTS any recommendation must respect: rooms stay Calvino-shaped (one conceit organizing 10-16 furniture items, 250-450 words, present tense, spatial progression); the no-Polo-Khan-frame-voice ban stands; the parked conflicting-accounts ruling must not be resolved or pre-committed; furniture stays sourced from the three corpora (de Vries, Cooper, ARAS).
